t: The Luceco Outdoor LED Solar Wall Light delivers efficient and reliable exterior illumination. This wall-mounted fitting is ideal for installations where electrical wiring is challenging, such as lighting remote workshops, site entrances, or pathways, providing both security and convenience. It features a high-efficiency solar panel, powering an integrated 4000K cool white LED without mains electricity. A built-in PIR sensor offers a 180-degree, 6-metre detection range, activating the light only when motion is detected. The robust IP65-rated ABS body ensures weather resistance and long-lasting performance. Fixings are supplied for quick installation.
